'''Matthew Graff''' (also published as '''Matt Graff'''; ''Star Wars'' TCG handle '''Ferus''') is the design lead of the Independent Development Committee for the [[Star Wars Trading Card Game]].<ref name="kc15">[https://www.kendallcast.ninja/2022/11/corran-on-horm-15-matt-graff.html Corran on the Horm - 15 - Matt Graff], KendallCast (8 November 2022). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20221109040833/https://www.kendallcast.ninja/2022/11/corran-on-horm-15-matt-graff.html Internet Archive]. Audio: [https://archive.org/details/corran-on-the-horn-15-matt-graff Internet Archive].</ref> The 2019 IDC expanded rulebook credits him on the Jedi Knight design staff, graphic design, and typography.<ref name="rb2019">[https://swtcg.com/Content/PDFs/Rulebooks/2019_IDC_Reglamento.pdf Reglamento Expandido, Jedi Knight Edition], Independent Development Committee (2019), Apéndice C — Créditos. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20220610003615/https://swtcg.com/Content/PDFs/Rulebooks/2019_IDC_Reglamento.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> He was a guest on [[Kendall Halman]]'s [[Corran on the Horn]] episode 15 on 8 November 2022.<ref name="kc15" />
